codeReview.summary: The feature adds substantial cross-ops tests and covers many intended interactions, but two contract-critical assertions are only partially exercised: launchd-started watchdog behavior is tested without launchctl invocation checks, and the declared full lifecycle test does not actually execute a follow stream step.

issues.description: VAL-CROSS-OPS-003 explicitly calls for mocking launchctl and validating the launchd-started watchdog path, but the tests only generate/write a plist and then call poll_cycle directly. They do not exercise install_agent/load_agent or assert launchctl bootstrap/bootout invocation, so the launchd boundary is not validated in this cross-area feature.

VAL-CROSS-OPS-005 requires the full lifecycle to include a logs --follow streaming step. In test_full_lifecycle_sequence, Step 7 only writes and reads the log file directly and never invokes follow_log or the logs --follow command path, so the declared full-lifecycle flow is not actually verified end-to-end.

The follow tests stop background threads by injecting KeyboardInterrupt via ctypes.pythonapi.PyThreadState_SetAsyncExc. This technique is fragile and can introduce nondeterministic/flaky behavior across Python versions and runtimes.
